ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all direct and indirect owners, directors, officers, and signatories against OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists, Panama's FEM-observed list, and a dedicated PEP register; enhanced due diligence required for domestic and foreign PEPs, their family members and close associates per Article 24 of Law 23 of 2015 plus SMV Acuerdo 4-2011; ongoing negative-news monitoring, transaction monitoring, and annual re-screening via commercial screening databases such as World-Check or equivalent.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá - online name search and reservation portal (www.registropublico.gob.pa), including the Biblioteca Virtual and VidRI access modules.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be distinguishable from all existing registrations and must not be identical, deceptively similar, or an obvious phonetic imitation of an active entity; the corporate suffix 'Sociedad Anónima' or 'S.A.' is mandatory; Spanish and English denominations are permitted, and non-Latin scripts must be transliterated into the Latin alphabet with a Spanish-language pronunciation note.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name reservations are non-extendable; upon expiry, a fresh 'certificado de buscada' must be filed with a nominal fee. If the Registro Público rejects a proposed name, the resident agent must file a written administrative appeal ('recurso de apelación') with the Dirección General del Registro Público within 5 business days, or immediately re-submit the preferred name with a written disclaimer of similarity together with two or three alternate names to preserve the incorporation closing timeline.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for a licensed retail securities broker: SMV requires a physical office presence in Panama with occupied premises, local staff, segregated client accounts, and a resident compliance officer; virtual office arrangements are acceptable only for passive holding S.A. entities with no regulated activities.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High (~80% probability of an unannounced or scheduled on-site inspection within the first 12 months of broker-dealer licensing under SMV Acuerdo 4-2011; recurring periodic examinations thereafter).

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Panama Law No. 32 of 1927 on Sociedades Anónimas (General Corporation Law), as amended by Law No. 5 of 2017; Art. 1-30 (formation, capital, registered office, directors); Decree-Law No. 1 of 1999, Title IV for regulated securities intermediaries.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Dirección General del Registro Público (Mercantile Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation) or certified notarized 'Pablo' constitutional document, filed for mercantile inscription
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the articles may declare an authorized capital of USD 10,000 or more, with no escrow or initial deposit requirement for the offshore S.A.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the first meeting of the Board of Directors of the company be and is hereby convened and constituted; that the authorized capital set forth in the articles of incorporation be subscribed and issued to the initial shareholders; that the registered office at the address filed with the Public Registry be and is adopted as the corporation's statutory domicile; that the President, Treasurer and Secretary be appointed with full corporate powers; that the Compliance Officer be designated for AML duties under Decree-Law 1 of 1999; that the officers are authorized to open segregated client wire accounts, retain the corporate registered agent, and apply for the securities broker-dealer license; and that all prior administrative acts are ratified. This resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – PAN-INFO (online name search portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written, notarized application to the Public Registry requesting reservation of the corporate name 'Sociedad Anónima' style; verify absence of identical or confusingly similar registered entities; pay the official name search and reservation fee; obtain the 'Certificado de Búsqueda' reserving the name for a renewable period.
required_dossiers: Notarized application of the incorporator
Three proposed corporate name variants
Certificate of no-conflicting registration search
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File an administrative 'recurso de reconsideración' with the Public Registry or submit substitute name variants; legal counsel may purge any conflicting identical-name objection within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notario Público (Panamanian Notary) via retained corporate counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Escritura Pública de Constitución before a licensed notary; include articles of incorporation, by-laws, authorized capital, director/agent appointments, and intended securities brokerage purpose; pay the 'Derecho de Venta' (legal tender tax), and have the notary certify the deed before forwarding to the Public Registry.
required_dossiers: Name reservation certificate (Certificado de Búsqueda)
Copies of passport or identity documents of incorporators and subscribers
Draft articles of incorporation and by-laws
Registered agent acceptance letter
Legal tender tax payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Notary will correct technical defects immediately; if any incorporator is disqualified, substitute a new subscriber by marginal amendment and re-notarize the deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mercantile Inscription with the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Personas (Mercantile Registry)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized deed plus supporting documents with the Mercantile Section of the Public Registry; pay the inscription fee (approx. USD 150 plus municipality stamp); the Registry examines the deed and issues the 'Inscripción' and corporate 'Certificado de Persona Jurídica'.
required_dossiers: Notarized Public Deed of Incorporation
Legal tender tax payment stamp
Formal petition for inscription signed by counsel
Copy of resident agent license and acceptance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any 'reparos' (registry objections) in writing within 15 business days; use the 'anotación complementaria' procedure to correct clerical discrepancies without re-notarizing the core deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration (RUC) and Municipal Operating Notice (Aviso de Operación)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; Municipality of Panama – Fiscalization Bureau
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the certified incorporation certificate to the DGI to obtain a 'Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC)' for the corporation; then file the 'Aviso de Operación' with the municipality, specifying the commercial activity of securities intermediary (ISIC 6611) and pay the municipal business tax.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Public Registry inscription
Public deed of incorporation
Lease agreement or title over registered office
Identity documents of the legal representative
Duly completed municipal aviso de operación form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality queries the commercial activity, provide the SMV license application proof; a 'certificado de gestion' correction may be filed at the municipal fiscal desk to re-classify the business activity.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-licensing Submission to the Securities Regulator and AML Compliance Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores de Panamá (SMV)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the pre-application dossier for the broker-dealer license simultaneously with the incorporation phase: file the corporate formation evidence, compliance program, and the appointment of the Compliance Officer and AML officer; participate in the SMV 'fit and proper' review of shareholders and officers; thereafter obtain the provisional authorization to undertake brokerage operations.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Public Registry inscription and corporate charter
RUC certificate and municipal aviso de operación
AML-CFT manual and internal controls documentation
Compliance Officer appointment and sworn declaration
Bank references and proof of minimum operational capital deposit
Background certificates for directors and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Submit a supplementary response within 10 business days to the SMV's information request; remediation letters or personal appearance before the SMV Directorate may cure integrity objections; alternative: revise the corporate officer roster and re-submit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores de Panamá (SMV) – Licensing and Registration Directorate
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de Casa de Valores (Broker-Dealer License) and Corporate License for Retail Securities Intermediation under Decree-Law No. 1 of 1999, as amended by Law No. 67 of 2011

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) – Dirección de Evaluación Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category III Registration only – office-based financial services with no industrial discharge; Full EIA (Estudio de Impacto Ambiental) not required; electronic data center infrastructure subject to a simple environmental registration.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Resolution No. AG-0357-2008 on commercial wastewater discharge limits; no VOC or industrial emissions; regulated e-waste disposal under Law No. 8 of 2018; stormwater and solid waste handling per municipal ordinance and Panamanian general environmental hygiene standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá fire safety certificate for the office premises; SINAPROC (National Civil Protection System) operational safety clearance; municipal structural and occupancy inspection; Ministerial occupational health and safety inspection under MINSA (Ministerio de Salud) and the Seguro Social workplace clearance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), dependency of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF); official portal: https://dgi.mef.gob.pa; taxpayer self-service platform: e-Tax 2.0 / SICE (Sistema de Información de Clientes Externos) accessible via DGI web services; electronic invoicing subsystem: Facturación Electrónica DGI, with SMV (Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores de Panamá) as the concurrent securities regulator for the licensed Casa de Valores.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign shareholders act through a licensed Panamanian Resident Agent and counsel. Steps: (1) incorporate the Sociedad Anónima in the Registro Público de Panamá and file the Aviso de Operación (commencement notice) with DGI via Form 600/o or e-Tax 2.0; (2) apply for the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente), the sole TIN, submitting the certified articles of incorporation, Registro Público 'Ficha' excerpt, Resident Agent acceptance, officer/shareholder ID or passport copies, and the signed RUC application through e-Tax 2.0 or a notarized DGI form; (3) the RUC application simultaneously opens the ITBMS account, with principal activity coded ISIC 6611 / NAICS 523120; (4) obtain the Firma Digital (digital signature certificate from an AIG-accredited CA) to authenticate all e-Tax 2.0 and e-invoicing transactions; (5) obtain the SMV 'Casa de Valores' license (60-120 days) and the DGI Paz y Salvo before launching operations. No minimum capital and no local ownership are required; a Panama-domiciled Resident Agent is mandatory. Estimated DGI turnaround for the RUC is 5-10 business days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope — the Panamanian S.A. is an entity-level taxpayer (no pass-through, no check-the-box) subject to corporate income tax (ISR) at the 25% statutory rate only on Panamanian-source net income under the territorial principle of the Código Fiscal. For a retail offshore securities broker, income from execution, custody, CFDs, and margin services rendered to non-resident clients on foreign markets, contracted and settled abroad, is foreign-source and excluded from ISR and ITBMS. No CFC regime applies; dividends paid from non-taxed foreign-source profits are not subject to the 5% Panamanian dividend withholding. Tax-exempt-zone regimes (e.g., Semilla, PEAR) are not applicable to an SMV-licensed broker operating in the national territory.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panamanian law provides no US-style check-the-box election and no hybrid-mismatch election. Available statutory mechanisms: (i) 'Exportador de Servicios' election — a sworn declaration to DGI enabling 0% ITBMS on qualifying offshore services and access to input ITBMS 'reintegro' (refund/credit); (ii) ISR group consolidation election for affiliated Panamanian entities with 80%+ common ownership, subject to DGI notification; (iii) optional partial-payment regime under Article 699-A of the Código Fiscal (quarterly installments on gross revenue) as a proxy for final ISR; (iv) the small-taxpayer ITBMS exemption election, expressly unavailable to licensed securities intermediaries; (v) no treaty election is available, as Panama has no OECD-model DTTs relevant to brokerage income, only TIEAs, making territorial sourcing the sole structural reliance.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT — Impuesto a la Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (ITBMS), Código Fiscal Articles 1057 et seq.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: PAB 36,000 (B/.36,000, equivalent to US$36,000 under the 1:1 Balboa/USD constitutional peg), being the annual gross taxable turnover above which ITBMS registration, monthly returns, and e-invoicing become mandatory (Código Fiscal Art. 1918-C). An SMV-licensed securities brokerage is a de facto 'contribuyente' because its licensed activity carries material turnover; it must register for ITBMS from the first day of operations and will typically be administered as a Grande Contribuyente (large taxpayer) by DGI.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory 'Factura Electrónica' regime under DGI Resolutions 201-5455 and 202-4580, as consolidated by the Código de Procedimiento Tributario (Ley 254 de 2024). All taxpayers, including Casas de Valores, must issue invoices through DGI-authorized e-invoicing operators or the DGI free web tool; each invoice is transmitted in near-real time over REST/SOAP API to the DGI clearance platform, automatically validated, and returned with a unique Código de Trazabilidad and QR code that must appear on the invoice before delivery to the client; digital stamping via Firma Digital is required, and legacy pre-printed paper invoices are no longer admissible as tax documents.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Two layers apply. (a) Territorial exclusion: brokerage, CFD, and advisory services to non-resident clients where the order is routed to and executed on foreign venues, settlement occurs in the client's overseas account, and the services are not used or exploited in Panama are foreign-source and outside the ITBMS base entirely; no zero-rating is needed. (b) 'Exportador de Servicios' convention: where DGI re-characterizes any element as a Panamanian service (e.g., local advisory or Panama-listed asset custody), the exporter election zero-rates the invoice at 0% and activates the input ITBMS credit/refund path. Eligibility conditions: non-resident certification of the client (tax-domicile affidavit), a written service agreement stating foreign situs and offshore benefit, SMV order-routing evidence, and proof that consideration was collected from abroad.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración Única Aduanera (DUA) filed via SICE/VUPEA — required only when physical goods (e.g., computer hardware, banknotes) cross the border; not applicable to pure offshore service exports
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (goods only); for services: executed brokerage agreement, ISIC 6611 scope statement, and SMV order-routing records evidencing execution on foreign exchanges

Inward Remittance Certificate — bank credit advice or SWIFT MT103/MT202 showing settlement of foreign-source fees received from the non-resident client within the repatriation window and credited to the S.A.'s Panamanian bank account
DGI Exporter of Services annual declaration and the client's non-residency tax-domicile affidavit, together with segregated client account statements from the foreign clearing venue
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Panama is fully dollarized with no exchange-control statute, so the 180-day window represents the DGI's practical evidentiary expectation that foreign-source revenue be 'realizada' (materialized) in the S.A.'s books; collections deferred beyond 12 months without documented agency or custody justification invite recharacterization as Panamanian-source income. Fraudulent zero-rating or refund claims trigger Código Fiscal Articles 748-760: a 100% surcharge on evaded ITBMS plus interest at 1.5% per month (18% annual) from the default date; the tax reassessment window is 3 years, extended to 6 years for unfiled returns and 10 years for fraud or missing records. Law 8 of 2010 criminalizes tax evasion with 2-5 years imprisonment, and DGI will claw back every 'reintegro' credit with doubling where exporter status was obtained by misrepresentation. Concurrently, the SMV may impose administrative fines on licensed Casas de Valores for false or incomplete books and suspend the securities license.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP). Panama has no de jure central bank; the SBP is the statutory banking regulator and licensing authority for banks, foreign-exchange houses and payment-service providers. Banco Nacional de Panamá acts as fiscal agent and clearing banker for the State, while the Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores (SMV) supervises licensed securities brokers under Decree-Law 1 of 1999, as amended notably by Law 60 of 2012. These authorities jointly define the de facto monetary-banking supervisory perimeter for USD clearing, treasury operations and correspondent banking in Panama.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama is fully dollarized. The Balboa (PAB) exists only as a notional unit at fixed 1:1 parity with the USD, and the USD is the sole circulating legal tender. Both capital and current account transactions are freely convertible, with no central-bank approvals, currency budgets, exchange-control registration, or remittance surcharges. For the territorial-tax Sociedad Anónima licensed as an offshore securities broker under ISIC 6611, income earned outside Panama is excluded from the Panamanian income-tax base; Panama-sourced income is taxed at 25%, and dividends remitted to non-resident shareholders are exempt from Panamanian withholding tax. The only practical hurdles are AML/EDD screening by SBP-regulated banks, documentary evidence of lawful source of funds, and SMV compliance on client-asset segregation and margin financing.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Panama imposes no export-proceeds surrender, conversion, or retention rules. There is no statutory timeline or mandatory conversion ratio for export trade receipts or any other foreign-currency earnings, because the USD is legal tender and banks may freely maintain foreign-currency balances. Accordingly, the brokerage's operating receipts, including client money in segregated accounts and commissions in USD or other convertible currencies, are not subject to any surrender obligation, central-bank preclearance, or conversion tax, and may be applied directly to settlement, disbursement, and treasury management.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Medium as an auxiliary disbursement rail; Low as the sole primary treasury banker. Any entity engaged in money or value transfer, payment initiation, or e-money issuance must be licensed by the SBP under the Panamanian Banking Law (Decree-Law 9 of 1998) or hold a valid SBP payment-service provider authorization. An offshore digital EMI not licensed or recognized by the SBP cannot legally hold settlement accounts for the broker's Panamanian client funds and will not be accepted by SBP-regulated banks as a pass-through account absent demonstrated regulatory equivalence. A non-client treasury-side balance may be held with an approved EMI maintaining a qualifying arrangement with an SBP-licensed partner bank, executing SWIFT-compliant MT103 messages, and receiving a favorable AML risk opinion from the broker's compliance officer; crypto-asset-focused EMIs are prohibited for any client-money function.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory in practice for the relevant business class. At minimum, two statutory directors (or the sole director where the structure permits), the ultimate beneficial owner(s), and the appointed AML compliance officer must attend an in-person interview at the bank's corporate or private-banking centre in Panama City for signature-card verification and original-document inspection. Remote opening is not generally available for an ISIC 6611 securities broker due to heightened market-integrity and investor-compensation risk; a limited number of banks accept a hybrid model where the physical first-contact interview is followed by video-call continuation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The entity presents bearer-share or nominee-share mechanics, triggering the Shell-Financial-Institution red flag and escalation to the bank's enhanced due diligence committee.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Public Registry excerpts confirming cancellation of bearer-share instruments, a notarized and apostilled share-register extract identifying all shareholders, a sworn beneficial-ownership declaration aligned with Law 254 of 2021, certified passports and residency proofs for all UBOs, a corporate-structure chart, and the resident corporate agent's sworn statement that the entity is an operating licensee, not a shell company.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The bank cannot verify the SMV brokerage licence or the co-requisite SBP authorization to hold client cash and securities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SMV resolution granting the broker-dealer licence, SBP authorization certificate for the segregated client account, the SMV-approved AML/CFT compliance manual, a legal opinion confirming license status, and the latest audited financial statements evidencing active operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: An inbound capital injection exceeding USD 1,000,000 is presented without demonstrable nexus to lawful business activity or shareholder financial capacity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized board resolution approving the capital increase or shareholder loan, the underlying subscription or loan agreement, commercial evidence of the shareholder's audited financial capacity, SWIFT MT103 advice evidencing the fund trail, and a source-of-wealth CDD report prepared under SMV and SBP standards.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Segregated client accounts may be used for proprietary trading or to channel funds to crypto-asset counterparties in red-flagged jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Payment-mapping matrix separating proprietary from client money, board-approved treasury and asset-segregation policies, contractual language in client agreements prohibiting crypto conversions, and counterparty due-diligence files containing legal-existence certificates, licence verification, beneficial-owner identification, and regulatory disciplinary-history screening.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity or quasi-equity capital is injected in USD via SWIFT MT103 (or MT202/202COV where a correspondent bank participates) from the shareholder's bank to the broker's operational USD account at an SBP-licensed bank in Panama. Panama does not require a national purpose-code filing; the beneficiary bank applies an internal transaction classification for capital or related-party financing and references the corporate RUC for lodgement confirmation. The supporting bundle comprising shareholder minutes, the amended Public Registry excerpt, share certificates or loan agreements, and evidence of the shareholder's financial capacity must be delivered within 10 to 15 business days of the lodgement. Central-bank preclearance is not required; the receiving bank performs standard CDD and beneficial-ownership verification before any onward release.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements are settled from the segregated client-money account or the proprietary operational account depending on purpose. Client trade settlements, margin calls, and withdrawal requests are cleared via SWIFT MT103 across the correspondent network, settling in USD through Fedwire and CHIPS. Institutional bond and equity purchases settle on a delivery-versus-payment basis through international central securities depositories (Clearstream and Euroclear), while commercial letters of credit governed by UCP600 support structured trade-finance disbursements. Every outbound instruction must carry the beneficiary legal name, full account details, and a client-code or contract reference to satisfy audit and investor-protection traceability.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: OTC spot FX contracts in USD/PAB parity pairs and major liquid currencies (EUR, GBP, CHF, JPY) with SBP-licensed credit institutions
Outright FX forwards with maturity up to twelve months under ISDA or local master agreements with SBP-regulated counterparty banks
Cross-currency swaps (USD versus EUR, GBP, JPY) for alignment of non-USD margin liabilities
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in restricted Latin American currencies (COP, CLP, PEN) utilized exclusively for hedging operational margin exposures and not for speculative purposes
Vanilla FX options written or purchased solely for hedge designation under the brokerage's treasury policy and subject to SMV suitability rules where client money is affected

stage_5.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Rules regarding annual confirmation for shareholding transfers
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial-source exemption is the dominant structural relief: brokerage commissions, CFD gains and derivative spreads booked from trading activity executed outside Panama for non-resident clients are excluded from the Panamanian ISR base (0% effective tax). No statutory income tax holiday applies to ordinary ISIC 6611 brokerage; special regimes such as SEM (Multinational Headquarters) and Panama-Pacifico are available only for qualifying physical/headquarters functions and are not suitable for a pure offshore booking centre.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 101 - Declaración Anual de Rentas de Personas Jurídicas (S.A.); filed electronically through the DGI Sede Electrónica/e-Tax portal (www.dgi.gob.pa).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; fiscal year as fixed in the S.A. articles, normally 1 January to 31 December.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than three (3) months after the fiscal year-end; for calendar-year taxpayers the deadline is 31 March of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 15-digit Registro Único de Contribuyente issued to the Sociedad Anónima.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: File under the S.A.'s Panamanian RUC only; do not enter a foreign tax reference of a non-resident shareholder.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Opening and closing dates of the fiscal year covered by the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must coincide exactly with the fiscal period recorded in the public registry and DGI taxpayer profile.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross Panama-source commission, spread, custody fee and other brokerage income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only income from Panamanian counterparties, Panama-listed securities or execution occurring within Panama; all other income is excluded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 402 - Ingresos de fuente extranjera y exentos
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income excluded from Panamanian tax by the territorial-source rule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim the territorial exclusion for foreign-market orders, non-resident client commissions and offshore CFD gains; retain client KYC, order routing and execution records proving the economic activity occurred abroad.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Costs and deductions attributable to Panama-source gross income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only documented expenses (facturas, bank statements) allocable to Panama-source revenue; costs of a purely foreign book are not deductible against Panamanian income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Panama-source gross income less allowable deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An offshore-only S.A. should present a null or fully exempt computation, never a negative tax base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax at the statutory 25% rate on net taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute 25% only if taxable Panama-source income exists; credit any monthly provisional payments (Form 103) in the corresponding field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Saldo a pagar / saldo a favor
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final net tax remittance or refund balance after credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Remit the balance by 31 March; a zero-tax return must still be filed to preserve the territorial exemption and to avoid the B/.50-B/.500 penalty.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a 10% surcharge on the assessed ISR where tax is due, and a fine of B/.50-B/.500 where no tax is due; late payment accrues a 2% monthly arrears surcharge plus legal interest; prolonged non-filing leads to inclusion in the DGI public defaulters registry and possible attachment of bank accounts.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 103 - Declaración Mensual de Pagos Provisionales del ISR; DGI Sede Electrónica/e-Tax portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly; obligatory only for taxpayers whose estimated annual taxable income exceeds USD 250,000.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on the 15th calendar day of the following month according to the annual DGI payment calendar; delay triggers a 2% monthly arrears surcharge.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax identification of the S.A. remitting the provisional payment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Panamanian RUC; no separate foreign identification is admissible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Estimated current-year Panama-source taxable base for the month.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Estimate zero for a purely foreign-source brokerage book; the DGI may demand a written technical explanation if repeated zero declarations are made.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount remitted, calculated as 25% of the estimated monthly taxable base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credit all provisional payments against the final Form 101 liability; overpayment is refundable or offsettable.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the monthly declaration carries a fine of B/.50-B/.500 and 2% monthly surcharge on unpaid provisional ISR, plus escalation to a larger administrative fine in cases of repeated non-compliance.
